title: China’s AI Push Is About More Than Catching the United States
dek: Beijing’s technology strategy is inseparable from a wider debate over economic security and national power.
author: LIN WEI
body:
International affairs are often described from far away. Deadline Journal begins from the opposite premise: political stories become clearer when we start with the people, institutions and historical memories closest to them.
